title: Law to give leave for bone marrow and organ donation
summary: This bill would require employers to provide up to 5 business days of unpaid leave for bone marrow donation and up to 20 business days of unpaid leave for living organ donation, in addition to existing sick leave. Subject to funding, the City would set up a program to pay employees for this unpaid leave at their regular pay rate. It would also direct the Health Department to create a voluntary honor roll recognizing City employees who donate bone marrow or organs.
